source_policy: Primary scientific publications, author/institution repositories, and official OpenSees documentation only.

sources.title: Geology of the InSight landing site on Mars
sources.evidence: Observed shallow duricrust and grains; interpreted deeper blocky ejecta and fractured basalt. Salt cementation is a hypothesis, not a layer-by-layer chemical assay.

sources.title: An Impact Crater Origin for the InSight Landing Site at Homestead Hollow, Mars
sources.evidence: Impact-generated fine and coarse regolith; estimates do not establish a universal 13 m interface.

sources.title: Mars global simulant MGS-1: A Rocknest-based open standard for basaltic martian regolith simulants
sources.evidence: Basaltic mineral analogy based on Gale/Rocknest; not measured InSight deep-layer mineral fractions.

sources.title: A Pre-Landing Assessment of Regolith Properties at the InSight Landing Site
sources.evidence: Pre-landing reference estimates; distinction between low-cohesion sand, bonded soils, density and friction. Not a calibration of the 3–13 m unit.

sources.title: Numerical Modeling of the Nonlinear Cyclic Response of Shallow Foundations
sources.locator: PEER 2005/04, Chapter 3, Sections 3.3.1–3.3.5; printed pp. 27–37, PDF pp. 46–56
sources.evidence: OpenSees BNWF research evaluates ElasticPPGap, general hysteretic, QzSimple1, PySimple1 and TzSimple1. Earth sand/clay experiments, not Mars.

sources.title: Performance evaluation of a nonlinear Winkler-based shallow foundation model using centrifuge test results
sources.locator: Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 38, 679–698; accessible abstract
sources.evidence: Centrifuge validation for square/strip footings on Earth sand/clay. Publisher abstract checked; exact spring command names cross-checked with R3/R4.
sources.archive_status: 원문 PDF 미확보(서지·원 출처 링크 보관)

sources.title: Soil-Structure Interaction for Building Structures
sources.evidence: Describes OpenSees QzSimple2, PxSimple1 and TxSimple1 roles in 2D BNWF. Official 13 MB URL exceeded web parser size; contractor revision was read.

sources.title: ShallowFoundationGen implementation documentation
sources.locator: Example material commands for shallow foundations
sources.evidence: Official example uses QzSimple2, PySimple2, TzSimple2. Older literature also uses PxSimple1/TxSimple1 terminology.

sources.title: OpenSees bbarBrick documentation
sources.evidence: matTag must identify an nDMaterial in a 3D, 3-DOF model.

sources.title: OpenSees QzSimple1 documentation
sources.evidence: Capacity is a force, Z50 a displacement. Original backbones are pile-tip relations.

sources.title: OpenSees PySimple1 documentation
sources.evidence: Original p-y relation; capacity is a nodal force after multiplying distributed resistance by tributary length.

sources.title: OpenSees TzSimple1 documentation
sources.evidence: Original pile shaft t-z relation; capacity is a force after tributary-area conversion.

sources.title: OpenSees ElasticPPGap documentation
sources.evidence: Compression-only sign convention; default recentering differs from damage option.

sources.title: OpenSees Hysteretic documentation
sources.evidence: User-defined asymmetric envelopes, pinching, energy/ductility damage and unloading stiffness rules.

sources.title: OpenSees PressureDependMultiYield02 documentation
sources.evidence: Supports 3D, pressure-dependent moduli and cyclic contraction/dilation; example sand parameters are not Mars calibration.

sources.title: OpenSees DruckerPrager documentation
sources.evidence: 3D pressure-sensitive continuum model; strength, plastic volume change and hardening need calibration.
